reviews.text:
I’ve been  Anghami since 2013, and honestly it’s disappointing that after all these years, we’ve never received any special offers or discounts, not even a free month.

Instead of constantly reminding us that our subscription is about to expire or that it’s our last day to renew, it would be nice to see some appreciation for long-time users. Why not offer a free month or a discount once in a while to reward the people who have been supporting the app for so many years?

Loyal customers deserve to feel appreciated too.A little offer every now and then would make a big difference!

reviews.title: Extremely Poor Experience – Serious Security Concerns
reviews.text: Anghami has been nothing but frustrating lately. Constant crashes, repeated logouts, missing music, endless glitches, and unresolved issues have made the app increasingly unreliable. The worst part? After being signed out yet again, I logged in with my usual information and was given access to someone else’s account, while my own account and data appeared to be lost or replaced. This is a serious privacy and security concern, not just a technical glitch. I’m tired of waiting for solutions and receiving generic responses instead of actual fixes. Anghami needs to take responsibility, restore my original account, and address these ongoing failures. Completely unacceptable.

reviews.title: Full of bugs
reviews.text:
My use case is pretty simple. I have a playlist I like to keep playing over and over. I ask you to do ONE job yet you still fail at it. 1. First of all, the “previous song” and “next song” buttons disappeared recently. So when i am driving, i can only skip 5 seconds backwards or forward which obviously isn’t useful at all (why would i even want that?)
2. Anghami somehow allows artists to change the content of their songs/audio files. I totally understand you give people permission to delete their content. But changing it!?!! Completely surprising. I have a playlist of 114 audio files (Quran) that suddenly got shrinked to 30, most of them are different recordings from what I originally selected. I didn’t want to include them yet all of a sudden I woke up to a whole new playlist I didn’t want.
3. A bug that has been there since forever: if you play a song once, and replay the playlist, it starts from the end! You can imagine, as someone who likes to repeat my playlist of Quran, I find myself listening to the last 1 or 2 ayahs only, unless I manually start the file from the beginning (which no longer works easily because of the bug 1)
An 2008 mp3 player would do a better job at this, really!! I don’t need any of the fancy AI features, just get the basic music playing functionality working and I will be super grateful.
